# vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp#L1461-L1471) registers WSI protected swapchain tests under `wsi`; the parent dispatcher adds this root only outside Vulkan SC.

## Role

Implementation file that registers tests.

## Parameter Dimensions

Each WSI type receives a `swapchain` subgroup, which has `create` and `render` children from [`createSwapchainTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp#L1445-L1450). `create` is populated across `TEST_DIMENSION_LAST` dimensions at [`populateSwapchainGroup()`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp#L960-L967).

## Support / Feature Requirements

Both swapchain creation and render test groups call protected-context support at [`vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp#L955-L958) and [`vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/protected_memory/vktProtectedMemWsiSwapchainTests.cpp#L1435-L1438). The file also contains runtime skips for insufficient memory and unavailable protected swapchain creation.

## Verification Methods

The inspected registration shows create and render test functions; detailed pass/fail behavior is implemented inside their helpers, including swapchain-creation and basic-render paths.

## Test Principles Observed

- The WSI branch is platform-type driven.
- Because the root dispatcher excludes this branch under Vulkan SC, this page documents the non-VulkanSC registration path.
